_about: The corn stall's own data (js/cook/stations/corn.js; its order is this file's order, registered as Cook.Recipes.corn when it loads). S19 wave B (CK-67, Zafar 9 Nov, his yes to two screens): screen 1 is sekelo's option 3 on the one grill kit (js/cook/grill-kit.js): the raw cobs two by two on the stone band, the grill big on the left, the cooked tray on its right; screen 2, the flavour: each cob on its person's cream plate with their face circle, the six dressing bowls on the band with their word pills, each person asking for their own mix. `mechanic.levels`: sideMs how long one side takes on the grill, greenMs how long its green lasts; `palette` the dressings' colours (data, not code).
_band: SH-248 (Zafar, 10 Nov): this game's bottom row, read by St.stoneBand(S, {game}); "tray" for top-down things, "shelf" for side-on (docs/game-design/modes/cook.md)

station.name: Corn stall
station.verb: Grill, turn once, then what goes on
station.goal: Tap a cob on the band: it goes on the grill. When it glows, tap it to turn it; when it glows again, tap it: into the tray. Then each person's cob is on their plate: tap what they asked for and it goes on; tap their plate to give it to them.

phases.grill: Tap a cob for the grill. Turn it once when it glows; take it off when it glows again.
phases.dress: Tap what this person asked for: it goes on their corn. Tap their plate to give it to them.

mechanic._greenMs: S19 (CK-65; Zafar, 8 Nov: 'the green zone is way too short'): greenMs, how long the cob's green lasts on its heat ring, the cob ready to turn or lift from the green's start; at least chai's green at the same level (Mech.boil.times on data/stations/chai-tray.json's heat over the tray profile: L1 [0.66, 0.86] at 0.09 a second, half speed in the green, 4.44 s; L2 [0.66, 0.86] at 0.12, 3.33 s; L3 [0.70, 0.84] at 0.12, 2.33 s; L4 [0.72, 0.85] at 0.13, 2.0 s). Was the side's last tenth (ring.lo 0.9): 0.26-0.32 s

kitchen.about: Sprint 18 prep (7 Nov): see data/stations/eggs.json kitchen.about (the same shape in every kitchen game). The station's own station/words/mechanic keys are untouched.

recipe.ref: this file's order (below), registered as Cook.Recipes.corn by js/cook/stations/corn.js as its data loads (S19 wave B: one plate per person, each with their own mix); data/cook.json recipes.corn stays the old one-person shape until it is retired there
recipe._levels: cobs = people by level (1, 1, 2, 2: one cob each); dressings per person [min, max]; 'no' the chance of a 'not X' ask (L4). sideMs and greenMs by level are mechanic.levels.

order._about: S19 wave B (CK-67, his yes: 'first grill them all and then flavour them on the next screen ... then you can flavour different corns differently'): the order the engine says and the card shows. One cob per person (the count by level, as before: 1, 1, 2, 2); each person (the family, the asker first) asks for their own mix: one or two things at L1-L3, two or three at L4, sometimes a 'no' at L4; the frames are the old recipe's (order, and, no): no new Kutchi. The order is said as before ('Muke ba makai khape.', the number in the headline, principle 4); with two or more people each person's card heads their own 'Muke hakro makai khape.' (personHead, on the card only: silent), their rows under it; one person's card keeps the order's own head (as before, and as the kit lays it out: its face's tap area clear of the first item card, contract-83).
order.name: n.corn-on-the-cob
order.how: Put the cobs on the grill, turn each once, take them off when they're cooked; then put on each person's cob what they asked for and give it to them.

scene.view: S19 wave B (CK-67): the kitchen's marble worktop with the stone band (the kitchen family's scene; the stall's table backdrop went with the one-screen draft: 'make it the same as Sekelo')

plate._note: his yes (10 Nov): cream plates for corn

host.note: Nani's guide box stands in for Hannah Mami until her approved sheet exists (Zafar, 1 Nov)

layout._about: Every place in the 1600 x 900 design box, inside x 150-1450 (the narrowest play area shows that much). grill: the kit's layout's own numbers (trayW the cooked tray's width, bandLen a raw cob's length lying on the band, ringRoom the heat rings' room above the grill); plates: screen 2, each person's plate (d its most diameter, gap between two; its middle in the room above the bowls, a light's margin clear of them, face: the face circle's size as a share of the plate, at its upper left; cob: the cob's length as a share of the plate and its turn, degrees; dim: the plates of the people still waiting, a little faded, CMP-10); bowls: the six dressing bowls on the band (size: most diameter), each pill under its bowl at least the pill floor, never narrowed, a light's margin apart; one row, or two rows of three on a taller tray where one row can't hold them at the floor (a phone); ring: the kit's heat ring above each cob's top end (r); smoke; dress: how each dressing is drawn on a cob in code (kind: squeeze, crystals, powder, drizzle, specks; n: how many marks).

cob._note: the full run's K4: raw, turned (one side grilled: the picture after the turn), done; one canvas each, lying (its length the picture's width)

dressings._note: the mini run's T-2: six cream bowls; the six ids are the station's DRESS

onCob._note: the dressing on a cob is drawn in code (the art plan's question 3): scene.layout.dress
